sentences.en: So, he's more than doubled his net worth in basically a last few days with Trump media.
sentences.zh: 所以，通过特朗普媒体公司，他的净资产在短短几天内翻了一倍多。

sentences.en: And not a moment too soon, right?
sentences.zh: 而且来得正是时候，对吧？

sentences.en: Because as we've talked about on the show, Trump owes about every last cent of cash he has.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我们在节目中讨论过的，特朗普几乎欠下了他所有的现金。

sentences.en: I think it's an estimated $500 million or so to various courts.
sentences.zh: 据估计，他欠各级法院大约 5 亿美元左右。

sentences.en: And this would be very auspicious timing to suddenly have an extra $5 billion in his life.
sentences.zh: 如果能突然多出 50 亿美元，这对他来说真是太及时了。

sentences.en: It's a critical lifeline for him right now.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说现在是一根救命稻草。

sentences.en: There, of course, are limitations to how he can tap that money.
sentences.zh: 当然，他动用这笔钱还是有限制的。

sentences.en: But I think also it should not be understated.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得也不应低估这一点。

sentences.en: It's a huge bragging point for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说是一个巨大的吹嘘资本。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which he likes to go out and talk about being the most successful businessman on the planet.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢到处宣扬自己是地球上最成功的商人。

sentences.en: He can say, look, I built a company that's worth $7 billion overnight.
sentences.zh: 他可以说，看，我一夜之间建立了一家价值 70 亿美元的公司。

sentences.en: Where have you done that, Joe Biden?
sentences.zh: Joe Biden，你做到过吗？

sentences.en: Or where have you done that pretty much almost anyone other than a very select, rarefied group of tech startups?
sentences.zh: 或者除了极少数顶尖的科技初创公司，还有谁做到过？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: So tell us the story of how this company, which I think a lot of people candidly dismissed from the beginning as Trump's little kind of renegade corner of the Internet,
sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我们这家公司的故事，坦白说，很多人一开始都认为它只是特朗普在互联网上的一个小角落，

sentences.en: somehow became this, a real financial behemoth in a way.
sentences.zh: 它是怎么变成这样一个金融巨头的？

sentences.en: What is that story?
sentences.zh: 这个故事是怎么回事？

sentences.en: So you have to go back to January 2021.
sentences.zh: 你得回到 2021 年 1 月。

sentences.en: Trump is kicked off of what was then Twitter after the January 6th riots at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 在国会大厦 1 月 6 日骚乱后，特朗普被当时的 Twitter 封杀了。

sentences.en: And not just Twitter, right?
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是 Twitter，对吧？

sentences.en: Facebook, Instagram.
sentences.zh: 还有 Facebook 和 Instagram。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was kicked off everything.
sentences.zh: 是的，他被所有平台封杀了。

sentences.en: But Twitter was really where he had lived, as we all knew.
sentences.zh: 但我们都知道，Twitter 才是他真正活跃的地方。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Tens of millions of followers.
sentences.zh: 拥有数千万粉丝。

sentences.en: Tens of millions.
sentences.zh: 数千万。

sentences.en: So Trump is at this low point.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普当时处于低谷。

sentences.en: He's out of the White House.
sentences.zh: 他离开了白宫。

sentences.en: He's sort of down there in Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 他待在海湖庄园里。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, a blast from the paSt.
sentences.zh: 突然间，往事重现。

sentences.en: He gets approached by these two guys who had been contestants on his old reality show, The Apprentice.
sentences.zh: 他被两个曾经参加过他那档真人秀《飞黄腾达》(The Apprentice) 的选手找上了。

sentences.en: And their names are Andy Letinsky and Wes Moss.
sentences.zh: 他们叫 Andy Letinsky 和 Wes Moss。

sentences.en: I'm no dummy.
sentences.zh: 我可不是傻瓜。

sentences.en: No, I know.
sentences.zh: 不，我知道。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你懂的。

sentences.en: They're not particularly notable or famous people.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是特别出名或显眼的人。

sentences.en: I don't know if the word is stars on the show.
sentences.zh: 我不知道能不能称他们为节目明星。

sentences.en: To be perfectly honest, I want to see Mr. Trump as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我想尽可能多地见到特朗普先生。

sentences.en: Letinsky was a really young guy.
sentences.zh: Letinsky 当时是个很年轻的小伙子。

sentences.en: I chose to the men dominating the women.
sentences.zh: 我选择了那些压制女性的男性。

sentences.en: Wes Moss came up sort of as like almost like a frat boy type of character.
sentences.zh: Wes Moss 表现得几乎像个兄弟会男孩。

sentences.en: Andy, you're fired.
sentences.zh: Andy，你被解雇了。

sentences.en: Wes, you're fired also.
sentences.zh: Wes，你也一样被解雇了。

sentences.en: And they weren't particularly successful, but they go to Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们虽然没那么成功，但他们去找了特朗普。

sentences.en: And what exactly is their pitch to him?
sentences.zh: 他们到底向他推销了什么？

sentences.en: Their pitch is basically, forget about Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他们的推销基本上是：忘了 Twitter 吧。

sentences.en: Forget about all these other platforMs.
sentences.zh: 忘了其他所有平台吧。

sentences.en: Create your own platform.
sentences.zh: 创建你自己的平台。

sentences.en: Create your own social media company.
sentences.zh: 创建你自己的社交媒体公司。

sentences.en: It'll be great.
sentences.zh: 那会很棒。

sentences.en: You won't be censored.
sentences.zh: 你不会被审查。

sentences.en: You can say whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 你想说什么就说什么。

sentences.en: All your followers will come here.
sentences.zh: 你所有的粉丝都会来这里。

sentences.en: We'll make a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 我们会赚很多钱。

sentences.en: We'll be huge.
sentences.zh: 我们会变得非常强大。

sentences.en: What was Trump's response?
sentences.zh: 特朗普的反应是什么？

sentences.en: Well, he's intrigued, but he never really totally commits to anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他很感兴趣，但他从不完全承诺任何事情。

sentences.en: At that point, Trump is sort of taking a backseat on it.
sentences.zh: 当时，特朗普对这件事采取了退居二线的态度。

sentences.en: He's basically agreeing to lend his name, if nothing else.
sentences.zh: 他基本上只是同意借出自己的名字而已。

sentences.en: They sign an agreement that they're going to go out and sort of pitch the deal.
sentences.zh: 他们签署了一份协议，准备去推销这笔交易。

sentences.en: And the Apprentice guys know that they're going to need a lot of money to get this company off the ground.
sentences.zh: 这些《飞黄腾达》的选手知道，要让这家公司起步，需要大量的资金。

sentences.en: But they're not going to be able to turn to traditional Wall Street sources because Trump at this point is kind of toxic.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法求助于传统的华尔街资源，因为特朗普当时被视为“有毒”的资产。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's a toxic guy.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是个不受欢迎的人。

sentences.en: So the solution for the Apprentice guys to raise this money was to do something called a SPAC, which is these companies that have come into vogue during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以这些选手筹集资金的解决方案是利用所谓的 SPAC（特殊目的收购公司），这在疫情期间非常流行。

sentences.en: They're basically shell companies that go public, raise hundreds of million dollars from investors,
sentences.zh: 它们基本上是上市的空壳公司，从投资者那里筹集数亿美元，

sentences.en: and essentially their sole purpose is to go out and look for another company to buy.
sentences.zh: 其唯一目的就是寻找另一家公司进行收购。

sentences.en: It's basically money in a bank account that's just sitting there to be transferred over to the private company that you buy.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是银行账户里的一笔钱，等着转给被收购的私人公司。

sentences.en: So for the private company that ends up merging, it's a great deal because they get tons of cash where they had nothing the day before.
sentences.zh: 对于最终合并的私人公司来说，这是一笔划算的交易，因为他们前一天还一无所有，转眼就得到了大笔现金。

sentences.en: And the other advantage of a deal with the SPAC is that beyond the cash, the private company becomes a public company,
sentences.zh: 与 SPAC 交易的另一个优势是，除了现金，私人公司还能变成上市公司，

sentences.en: and that gives it the ability to sell stock to investors and go out and raise more money that way.
sentences.zh: 这使它有能力向投资者出售股票，从而筹集更多资金。

sentences.en: And then through that merger, eventually the two companies coming together, the company that Trump is going to be ostensibly heading, the social media company,
sentences.zh: 然后通过这次合并，两家公司最终合二为一，特朗普名义上将领导的这家社交媒体公司，

sentences.en: would get everything the SPAC had raised from investors.
sentences.zh: 将获得 SPAC 从投资者那里筹集到的所有资金。

sentences.en: So all that cash is going to come flooding into the company the Apprentice guys envision.
sentences.zh: 所以所有的现金都会涌入这些选手设想的公司中。

sentences.en: So if I'm understanding this plan correctly, the Apprentice guys envision a plan where they go off, they find a SPAC that has raised a bunch of money,
sentences.zh: 如果我没理解错这个计划，这些选手设想了一个计划：他们去寻找一家已经筹集了大量资金的 SPAC，

sentences.en: and eventually it will merge with the Trump social media company they envision building.
sentences.zh: 最终它将与他们设想建立的特朗普社交媒体公司合并。

sentences.en: And when that marriage is consummated, their work will be over and they will hopefully have a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 当这种联姻达成时，他们的工作就完成了，他们希望能赚到一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Basically, that's exactly what their goal was.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这正是他们的目标。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the Apprentice guys are out there in the market looking for a SPAC.
sentences.zh: 所以这些选手在市场上寻找 SPAC。

sentences.en: But given the lack of really any kind of business plan, they don't go to like the top flight guys out there.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到他们几乎没有任何商业计划，他们没有去找那些顶尖的机构。

sentences.en: They end up at the bottom of the barrel.
sentences.zh: 他们最终只能找底层的公司。

sentences.en: And so they end up with essentially a very no-name-sounding SPAC called Digital World Acquisition Corporation.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最终找到了一家名不见经传的 SPAC，叫“数字世界收购公司”(Digital World Acquisition Corporation)。

sentences.en: Digital World has its IPO in September of 2021, raises $300 million.
sentences.zh: 数字世界公司在 2021 年 9 月进行了首次公开募股，筹集了 3 亿美元。

sentences.en: Lo and behold, like a month after a press release comes out late at night,
sentences.zh: 果不其然，一个月后，深夜发布了一份新闻稿，

sentences.en: Donald Trump and Trump Media are merging with Digital World Acquisition Corp.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普和特朗普媒体公司将与数字世界收购公司合并。

sentences.en: I remember people pinging me, is this a joke?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时人们纷纷发消息问我，这是在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: Because most people, I'm sure, had never heard of Digital World.
sentences.zh: 因为我相信大多数人从未听说过“数字世界”。

sentences.en: And even more people had no idea that Trump was even doing a social media company.
sentences.zh: 甚至更多人根本不知道特朗普还在搞社交媒体公司。

sentences.en: Because while all this is going on and they're trying to put a deal together, the social media platform that will become Truth Social hasn't even launched,
sentences.zh: 因为在这一切发生、他们试图达成交易的同时，那个后来成为“真实社交”的社交媒体平台甚至还没有上线，

sentences.en: and it won't do so for months later.
sentences.zh: 而且还要过好几个月才会上线。

sentences.en: But there's trouble right away.
sentences.zh: 但麻烦很快就来了。

sentences.en: The Securities Exchange Commission comes in and announces it's opened an investigation into how this deal came together, looking into whether Digital World violated securities laws
sentences.zh: 证券交易委员会介入并宣布对这笔交易的达成方式展开调查，以查明Digital World是否违反了证券法，

sentences.en: by engaging in merger talks ahead of time, which technically isn't kosher in the way SPACs are supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 即提前进行合并谈判，这在SPAC（特殊目的收购公司）的运作方式上严格来说是不合规的。

sentences.en: But this investigation just drags on and on and on, and it's going to delay everything.
sentences.zh: 但这项调查拖了又拖，没完没了，这势必会延误一切进展。

sentences.en: So this is turning out to be a pretty big mess.
sentences.zh: 所以这件事正演变成一个相当大的烂摊子。

sentences.en: Very big mess.
sentences.zh: 非常大的烂摊子。

sentences.en: It looks like this deal's never going to happen.
sentences.zh: 看起来这笔交易永远也不会成功了。

sentences.en: And finally, when they launched Truth Social in early 2022,
sentences.zh: 最后，当他们在2022年初推出“真实社交”（Truth Social）时，

sentences.en: it's a little bit of a joke.
sentences.zh: 简直像个笑话。

sentences.en: It's like this sort of very early version of Twitter when it's sort of clunky.
sentences.zh: 就像推特非常早期的版本，感觉笨手笨脚的。

sentences.en: How clunky?
sentences.zh: 有多笨拙？

sentences.en: You were on it?
sentences.zh: 你也用过？

sentences.en: Yeah, I actually think I was one of the first people to get in, which I thought was sort of funny because I said I was from the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我其实觉得自己是第一批加入的人之一，我觉得这挺有意思的，因为我当时说我是《纽约时报》的。

sentences.en: They actually verified me.
sentences.zh: 他们竟然还给我认证了。

sentences.en: Mazel tov.
sentences.zh: 恭喜恭喜。

sentences.en: There was very little traffic.
sentences.zh: 上面的流量非常少。

sentences.en: It was almost like you'd post something and you could literally hear the quickness.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像是你发了条动态，都能真切地听到那种冷清感。

sentences.zh: 它们是幻想股票。

sentences.en: They take on a life of their own.
sentences.zh: 它们有着自己的生命力。

sentences.en: We had this during the pandemic with GameStop and AMC.
sentences.zh: 疫情期间，我们见识过游戏驿站和AMC的情况。

sentences.en: The shares run up to ridiculous levels, driven largely by retail investors.
sentences.zh: 在散户投资者的推动下，股价涨到了荒谬的水平。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just to remind people, those were stocks where retail investors were buying shares.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下大家，那些股票都是散户投资者在买入。

sentences.en: It felt like because they wanted to send a message, largely anti-establishment message, they were mad at a hedge fund that had shorted it.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是因为他们想传达某种信息，主要是反建制的信息，他们对做空该股的对冲基金感到愤怒。

sentences.en: In one case, I remember, they wanted to make a point.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次，他们就是想表达个观点。

sentences.en: They wanted to stick it to the man.
sentences.zh: 他们想给当权者一点颜色看看。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And also, it becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也会变成一种自我实现的预言。

sentences.en: It becomes a mania.
sentences.zh: 它变成了一种狂热。

sentences.en: Then others sort of see this and get in because you feel like if you keep buying, it's never going to fall.
sentences.zh: 然后其他人看到这种情况也跟风买入，因为你会觉得只要一直买，它就永远不会跌。

sentences.en: It's never going to go down.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会下跌。

sentences.en: And that can work for a while, but eventually gravity will always take hold at some part.
sentences.zh: 这招或许能奏效一阵子，但最终重力总会在某个时刻发挥作用。

sentences.en: I'm not saying that Trump media is going to collapse, but at some point, something will happen that will trigger the stock to sell off.
sentences.zh: 我不是说特朗普媒体公司会崩盘，但在某个时刻，总会发生些什么触发股票抛售。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's fragile.
sentences.zh: 它很脆弱。

sentences.en: It's fragile, right.
sentences.zh: 它很脆弱，没错。

sentences.en: It's not sustainable at this level.
sentences.zh: 它在目前这个水平是不可持续的。

sentences.en: But when it's happening, it's hard for me or anyone to give you a rational reason.
sentences.zh: 但当这种事发生时，无论是对我还是对任何人来说，都很难给出一个理性的解释。

sentences.en: And that's why there's this old thing, a rational exuberance.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么有句老话叫“非理性繁荣”。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily unusual.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是不寻常的。

sentences.en: It's just that it's unusual because you have a very loyal investor base to him personally that is driving a lot of these surges in the stock.
sentences.zh: 之所以说它不寻常，是因为他个人拥有一个非常忠诚的投资者群体，正是他们在推动股价的多次飙升。

sentences.en: I'm really curious how Trump's position in this presidential campaign factors into what you just described because it feels like this irrational exuberance has to be linked somewhat to the reality that he is the now lead candidate in the polls for reelection.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇特朗普在这次总统竞选中的地位，是如何影响你刚才描述的情况的，因为感觉这种非理性繁荣，多少与他现在是民调中领先的连任候选人这一现实有关。

sentences.en: But I'm curious what investors think about that, how they link his chances of becoming president with the financial health and future promise of this company.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇投资者对此怎么看，他们是如何将他当选总统的可能性与这家公司的财务健康状况和未来前景联系起来的。

sentences.en: It's definitely, I think, going to be a barometer, sort of Trump and his political fortunes.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这绝对会成为一个晴雨表，某种程度上反映了特朗普及其政治命运。

sentences.en: I mean, just by way of example, the SPAC stock started to soar this year when Trump was on the verge of locking up the nomination.
sentences.zh: 我是说，举个例子，这家SPAC公司的股票今年开始飙升，正是因为特朗普即将锁定提名。

sentences.en: It was around the time DeSantis dropped out in New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 那大约是在德桑蒂斯在新罕布什尔州退选的时候。

sentences.en: The stock surged like 60, 70 percent overnight.
sentences.zh: 股价一夜之间飙升了约60%到70%。

sentences.en: It was really because people were like, hey, Trump is going to be the nominee and we're going to be going forward.
sentences.zh: 这确实是因为人们觉得，嘿，特朗普要成为候选人了，我们要向前看了。

sentences.en: But can you just explain that?
sentences.zh: 但你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: What does one have to do with the other?
sentences.zh: 这两者之间有什么关系？

sentences.en: In theory, it doesn't have anything to do with it, but it's like a proxy for him.
sentences.zh: 理论上讲，它们毫无关系，但它就像是他的一个代理指标。

sentences.en: It's also the idea that as long as Trump is still politically viable, Trump media is viable.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种观念，即只要特朗普在政治上还有生命力，特朗普媒体公司就有生命力。

sentences.en: Truth social is viable.
sentences.zh: “真实社交”就有生命力。

sentences.en: And presumably a president 2.0 Trump is the best possible situation for this stock price.
sentences.zh: 而且可以推测，特朗普2.0时代对这个股价来说是最好的情况。

sentences.en: If he wins, I think it probably will be a high watermark for the stock.
sentences.zh: 如果他赢了，我认为这很可能会成为该股的历史最高点。

sentences.en: And I would just think given the dynamic with the election right now, it's hard to see the stock not continuing to rise at least until November.
sentences.zh: 考虑到目前的选举动态，我认为很难想象股价不会至少持续上涨到十一月。

sentences.en: OK, I want to turn now to Trump's access to this very valuable stock at a time when, as we all know, he seems to need money.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我想谈谈特朗普在众所周知他似乎急需用钱的时候，如何获取这笔价值不菲的股票资产。

sentences.en: How and when could he tap into this money?
sentences.zh: 他如何以及何时才能动用这笔钱？

sentences.en: OK, so at the moment, he actually can't.
sentences.zh: 好的，目前他实际上还不能动用。

sentences.en: Can't.
sentences.zh: 不能。

sentences.en: He can't.
sentences.zh: 他不能。

sentences.en: There's what's called a lockup, a restriction.
sentences.zh: 这有所谓的锁定期，即限制措施。

sentences.en: It's not just for him.
sentences.zh: 这不仅针对他。

sentences.en: It's for any major shareholders.
sentences.zh: 对任何主要股东都一样。

sentences.en: They can't sell for six months.
sentences.zh: 他们六个月内不能出售。

sentences.en: It's actually not unusual in these kind of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这其实并不罕见。

sentences.en: The logic is you don't want important people to the company, important shareholders to bolt as soon as the deal goes through.
sentences.zh: 逻辑是，你不希望对公司重要的人，即重要股东，在交易达成后立即抛售。

sentences.en: But there are other ways he can get around that.
sentences.zh: 但他还有其他绕过这个限制的方法。

sentences.en: One way is for the board.
sentences.zh: 一种方法是找董事会。

sentences.en: It's a seven-member board.
sentences.zh: 这是一个七人董事会。

sentences.en: They're all loyalists for the most part.
sentences.zh: 他们大多都是他的忠实拥护者。

sentences.en: They could allow him to sell shares early.
sentences.zh: 他们可以允许他提前出售股票。

sentences.en: I personally think that's unlikely because it shows a lack of faith.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为这不太可能，因为这显示出缺乏信心。

sentences.en: You know, just like if he had jumped from Truth Social onto Twitter, this would be the same kind of message being sent.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像如果他从“真实社交”跳槽到推特一样，这会发出同样的信号。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: What they could do is allow him to pledge those shares, meaning he can go out and get a loan, use it as collateral.
sentences.zh: 他们可以做的是允许他质押这些股票，这意味着他可以去贷款，用股票作为抵押品。

sentences.en: The shares don't get sold, but you're giving them to some other like a bank or probably more likely a hedge fund.
sentences.zh: 股票没有被卖掉，但你把它们交给了其他人，比如银行，或者更有可能是对冲基金。

sentences.en: So that would be a way for him to monetize his stock without actually selling it.
sentences.zh: 所以，这对他来说是一种在不实际出售的情况下将股票变现的方法。

sentences.en: So if Trump really wanted to, he could find a way working through this board of loyalists to tap into this money pretty quickly if he so chose to.
sentences.zh: 所以如果特朗普真的想，他可以通过这个忠诚的董事会找到办法，如果他愿意的话，很快就能动用这笔钱。

sentences.en: If he asked the board to do it, I think there's probably a good chance the board would do it.
sentences.zh: 如果他要求董事会这样做，我认为董事会很有可能会照办。

sentences.en: But if he doesn't really need the money that desperately, I think he probably won't.
sentences.zh: 但如果他不是真的那么急需用钱，我想他可能不会这么做。

sentences.en: And I think the board would be reluctant because it doesn't really help anyone to have lots of stock coming out into the market.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为董事会会很勉强，因为让大量股票涌入市场对谁都没有好处。

sentences.en: That only will probably depress the price of the share.
sentences.zh: 那很可能会压低股价。

sentences.en: And it doesn't help to have the face of the company, the man whose initials are on the ticker,
sentences.zh: 而且让公司的门面，那个名字缩写都在股票代码上的人，

sentences.en: selling the stock because that suggests he doesn't have a tremendous amount of faith in the business.
sentences.zh: 去抛售股票，这对他也没好处，因为那暗示他对这家公司没有太大的信心。

sentences.en: And that might trigger a sell-off, which would undermine the value of the rest of his stock.
sentences.zh: 这可能会引发抛售，从而削弱他剩余股票的价值。

sentences.en: It's a pretty bad cycle to start.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当糟糕的恶性循环。

sentences.en: That's like the event that starts to send the sell-off.
sentences.zh: 那就像是引发抛售的导火索。

sentences.en: And even at that point, even your most loyal shareholders may say, well, I don't want to be left the last one holding the bag.
sentences.zh: 即便到了那个时候，即使是你最忠诚的股东也可能会说，好吧，我可不想成为最后一个接盘的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I want to step way back for just a minute and think about the larger meaning of what has happened with Truth Social.
sentences.zh: 我想退后一步，花点时间思考一下“真实社交”所发生事件的更深层含义。

sentences.en: I mean, I've covered a lot of Trump's businesses through the years, investigated them when he was a candidate in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我是说，多年来我报道过很多特朗普的生意，在他2016年参选时也调查过它们。

sentences.en: And it really strikes me that of all the businesses he's been in, real estate, casinos, Trump University, selling Trump steaks, Trump wine, whatever, you know, those made money.
sentences.zh: 我印象深刻的是，在他涉足的所有生意中，房地产、赌场、特朗普大学、卖特朗普牛排、特朗普葡萄酒等等，你知道，那些都是赚钱的。

sentences.en: This, in some ways, feels like the least sound business of all.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，这感觉是所有生意中最不稳健的一个。

sentences.en: And yet it has made him the richest by far.
sentences.zh: 然而，它却让他成为了迄今为止最富有的人。

sentences.en: That's a little bit weird to wrap your head around.
sentences.zh: 这让人有点难以理解。

sentences.en: What does that tell you about the nature of Trump and these investors who believe in this?
sentences.zh: 这说明了特朗普以及这些相信他的投资者具有什么样的特质？

sentences.en: It is weird.
sentences.zh: 确实很奇怪。

sentences.en: I'm not a politics reporter, but from a business perspective, this has given me a little bit better insight into his seemingly unending kind of popularity and support.
sentences.zh: 我不是政治记者，但从商业角度来看，这让我对他那种似乎无穷无尽的受欢迎程度和支持率有了更好的了解。

sentences.en: There's the old adage on Wall Street, never fall in love with the stock.
sentences.zh: 华尔街有句老话，永远不要爱上某只股票。

sentences.en: But the reality is a lot of his shareholders here are in love with the stock.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，他的很多股东确实爱上了这只股票。

sentences.en: They have fallen in love with it and they're in love with him to a large extent.
sentences.zh: 他们爱上了它，而且在很大程度上也爱上了他本人。

sentences.en: And when you have that sort of mix there, it allows a stock to soar to sort of unreal levels that we're seeing now.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有这种组合时，它就能让股价飙升到我们现在看到的这种不切实际的水平。

sentences.en: And who knows where it goes from here.
sentences.zh: 谁知道接下来会怎样。

sentences.en: But for the moment, it's clearly working for Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 但目前看来，这对特朗普先生显然是有效的。

sentences.en: Well, Matt, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，马特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: When the stock market closed on Wednesday afternoon, shares of Trump's new media company reached $66 a share, up 14% from the previous day.
sentences.zh: 周三下午股市收盘时，特朗普新媒体公司的股价达到每股66美元，较前一天上涨了14%。

sentences.en: As of this morning, the company is worth $9.4 billion.
sentences.zh: 截至今天上午，该公司市值已达94亿美元。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: Authorities said that the six missing workers who were on the Francis Scott Key Bridge when it collapsed are now presumed dead.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，弗朗西斯·斯科特·基大桥坍塌时在桥上的六名失踪工人现已被推定死亡。
zh_words: 弗朗西斯·斯科特·基大桥

sentences.en: The workers were members of a construction crew who were repairing masonry and potholes when a massive container ship plowed into the bridge on Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 这些工人是一个施工队的成员，周二早上，一艘巨大的集装箱船撞向大桥时，他们正在修补砖石和坑洼。

sentences.en: This is no ordinary bridge.
sentences.zh: 这可不是一座普通的桥。

sentences.en: This is one of the cathedrals of American infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 这是美国基础设施的圣殿之一。

sentences.en: Experts say that rebuilding the bridge, which carried 30,000 vehicles a day, will probably take years and cost hundreds of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，重建这座每天承载3万辆车通行的大桥，可能需要数年时间，耗资数亿美元。

sentences.en: A reality acknowledged by the Secretary of Transportation, Pete Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 交通部长皮特·布蒂吉格也承认了这一现实。

sentences.en: So the path to normalcy will not be easy, it will not be quick, it will not be inexpensive, but we will rebuild together.
sentences.zh: 所以，通往正常的道路不会容易，不会迅速，也不会便宜，但我们将共同重建。

sentences.en: And the first ever congestion pricing system in the United States crossed a major milestone on Wednesday when New York officially approved tolls for cars driving through the busiest sections of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 周三，美国首个拥堵收费系统跨越了一个重要里程碑，纽约正式批准对驶经曼哈顿最繁忙路段的车辆征收通行费。

sentences.en: The system, modeled on those in London and Singapore, is designed to significantly reduce traffic and air pollution.
sentences.zh: 该系统仿照伦敦和新加坡的模式，旨在显著减少交通拥堵和空气污染。

sentences.en: The tolls, $15 for most passenger cars and as much as $36 for large trucks, are expected to raise $1 billion a year for mass transportation.
sentences.zh: 这些通行费，大多数乘用车为15美元，大型卡车最高可达36美元，预计每年将为公共交通筹集10亿美元。

sentences.en: The new system could still be blocked by several lawsuits seeking to derail it, but if those cases fail, the tolls will begin in mid-June.
sentences.zh: 新系统仍可能因几起试图阻挠它的诉讼而受阻，但如果这些案件失败，通行费将于六月中旬开始征收。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人激动的斗争之中。
